# Otrish Neshin (اتریش‌نشین)
> The authoritative, independent knowledge hub and service portal for Persian speakers living in or migrating to Austria.

## About
Otrish Neshin (اتریش‌نشین) provides legal guidelines, interactive calculators (Rot-Weiß-Rot-Karte points, Austrian Brutto-Netto salary 14 payments), MA 35 immigration tracking, residency checklists, Vienna city directories, certified translation resources, and Austrian tax guidance (FinanzOnline & Arbeitnehmerveranlagung). All content is aligned with official Austrian legal databases (RIS), the Austrian Ministry of Finance (BMF), the Austrian Health Insurance Fund (ÖGK), and the Public Employment Service (AMS).

## Core Pillars & Direct Resources
- [Rot-Weiß-Rot-Karte (RWR Card) Calculator 2026](https://otrish-iran.ir/rwr-card): Interactive points calculator for skilled workers, shortages (Mangelberufe), and graduates under Austrian AuslBG.
- [Brutto-Netto Gehaltsrechner Österreich 2026](https://otrish-iran.ir/brutto-netto-rechner): Precise salary calculator with 14 payments, progressive tax brackets, and ÖGK social security.
- [MA 35 Einwanderung & Staatsbürgerschaft Wien](https://otrish-iran.ir/ma35): Official guidelines, delay complaints under § 73 AVG, appointment booking, and residency permit renewal.
- [Arbeitnehmerveranlagung & FinanzOnline Guide](https://otrish-iran.ir/tax-return): Step-by-step annual tax return, commuter allowances (Pendlerpauschale), and Familienbonus Plus.
- [ID Austria Activation Guide](https://otrish-iran.ir/id-austria): Digital signature and government portal login for non-EU residents in Austria.
- [Kassenarzt & ÖGK Healthcare Directory](https://otrish-iran.ir/kassenarzt-directory): Doctors, pediatricians, dentists, and health insurance contracts in Vienna.
- [Vienna Meldezettel & Housing Registration](https://otrish-iran.ir/residency-conditions): 3-day mandatory address registration rules, rental law, and tenant rights.
- [Austrian Legal Terms Glossary](https://otrish-iran.ir/glossary): Bilingual Persian-German administrative terms and legal vocabulary.
- [Vienna vs Graz Cost of Living Comparison](https://otrish-iran.ir/compare-living): Empirical benchmarks for rent, transport, groceries, and utilities.

## Verification & Official Authority Sources
- Legal Information System of the Republic of Austria: https://www.ris.bka.gv.at
- City of Vienna Official Portal: https://www.wien.gv.at
- Austrian Federal Ministry of Finance (BMF): https://www.bmf.gv.at
- Austrian Health Insurance Fund (ÖGK): https://www.gesundheitskasse.at
- Public Employment Service Austria (AMS): https://www.ams.at
